niche: Mind Hacks, AI Secrets, Bizarre Body Science & Hidden Power Dynamics

ideas.title: The Impossible Fist Glitch
ideas.angle: An interactive challenge where the viewer tries to lift their ring finger while their middle finger is tucked under. It demonstrates a physical limitation of the human hand's tendons. It forces engagement as viewers fail and comment their results.
ideas.reason: Interactive physical challenges have the highest VVSA because viewers must pause or loop the video to attempt the movement. The 'Paralyzed Ring Finger' variant is a proven viral hook format.
sources: Journal of Hand Surgery: Tendon Interdependence

ideas.title: The Ben Franklin Request Hack
ideas.angle: A dark psychology trick explaining why asking someone for a small favor actually makes them like you more. It leverages cognitive dissonance to flip an enemy into a friend. High comment potential for people sharing their success stories.
ideas.reason: Social power dynamics are currently trending on TikTok and Shorts. Actionable 'villain' advice performs better than standard self-help due to the 'edge' factor.
sources: Cognitive Dissonance Theory by Leon Festinger

ideas.title: The Letter F Brain Blindness
ideas.angle: An interactive reading test showing a short sentence where the brain skip-reads the word 'OF'. It proves the brain processes 'OF' as a shape rather than a word. Viewers will rewatch to count again, driving APV over 100%.

hook.en: Your brain is lying to you.

ideas.reason: Visual 'blindness' tests are classic high-retention content. By challenging the viewer's intelligence, you trigger a 'verify' loop where they watch the text 3-4 times to find the missing letters.
sources: University of Cambridge: The Typoglycemia Study
Psychology Today: Why our brains skip words
